title: Timing plan for a 2-hour paper
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 70 (Timing plan template (portal worksheet))
intro: About 1 minute a mark. Fill in the question you should have reached at each check point, then check it in the exam.

head: Check point
Question I should be on
Marks so far (target)
What I do if I am behind

checklist: Do the questions I am sure of first; mark and move on if stuck for 2 minutes
Show every step: method marks need working
Round only at the end; write the unrounded value too
Check units, the accuracy asked for, and that I answered the question
Use the last 10 minutes to check estimates and return to skipped questions
Scientific calculator with a new battery
